description:
Binlog Cleartext Password — WARN0310

Scans binlog QUERY events for SQL statements containing a cleartext password literal (CREATE USER, ALTER USER, GRANT, SET PASSWORD). The password value is partially redacted in findings.

config_keys.label: Timeframe (hours)
config_keys.help: Only binlog events within this rolling window are scanned.

config_keys.label: Max findings per evaluation
config_keys.help: Caps the number of findings emitted in a single monitoring tick.
